title: A linked entry with no manufacturer takes the one picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only, part A, with the Manufacturer field left empty, so part A is not stocked at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description in the Description field.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  4. Pick any manufacturer in the Manufacturer field.
  5. Pick any category in the Category field.
  6. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  9. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The manufacturer shows in the Manufacturer field.

Step 5:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 6:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 8:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 9:

  • Part A's entry now shows the manufacturer you picked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R6b: “A linked entry with no manufacturer takes the one picked in the dialog. An entry that already has a manufacturer keeps it.”
  • S7-R6d: “A linked entry has a manufacturer only when it points to a manufacturer that exists in this organization. An entry that points to none takes the one picked in the dialog.”
